item.title: BIRDWATCH: Cold weather, strong results in Renfrew County waterfowl count
item.description: I just received the results of the 2026 Winter Waterfowl Count held on Saturday, Jan. 3, 2026. The weather on the count consisted of snow and some freezing rain, with temperatures below zero and an additional windchill factor. Eleven people participated in the event. item.title: Ottawa Valley history set to music: Marc Audet live in Pembroke
item.description: The Upper Ottawa Valley Heritage Centre will host local folk singer-songwriter Marc Audet for an evening of music and storytelling on March 14.
